newsitem.title: USA: Twelve companies line up for U.S. Stockpile lead.
newsitem.headline: Twelve companies line up for U.S. Stockpile lead.

text.p: The Defense National Stockpile Center said 12 companies put forward bids for surplus lead from the government.

The bidders were Louisiana Lead Products, Specialty Metals and Minerals, Hirsch Metals Corp, Parks Pioneer, East Penn Manufacturing, Canfield Technologies, Sloan Capital Corp, Allied Deals, Powerlab, Cambridge Street Metal, Ney Smelting and Refining, and Hochschild Partners.
Notice of any awards was due soon.
